basic_info.description: Beautiful Corner Unit with a large 2 bedroom 2 bathroom and a small den. Unit is one of the larger 2 bedroom layouts with an open balcony, in-unit laundry and beautiful wood flooring. Property boasts a new countertop, high end Thermador appliances. This is one of the best two bedroom units in San Francisco at this price. Conveniently located in SOMA close to the MOMA and the best the city has to offer. Perfect property for anyone who loves the city life. Common area includes a beautiful gym with Peloton bikes, an open bbq rooftop deck and full time lobby seating and doorman. Come make this One Hawthorne unit your new home!
